proposals.note: D6-symmetric block: RY(tied) → RZZ(tied, nearest-neighbor ring) → RY(tied) → RZZ(tied, distance-2 chords). 24 gates, 4 tied params. RZZ chosen over CNOT/CRX because readout is diagonal in Z basis, so RZZ directly seeds Z_iZ_j correlations. Two entangling layers (NN + NNN) give the linear readout access to all 15 pairwise observables without breaking dihedral symmetry. Fewer free params (4 vs 5 in best prior) reduces overfitting while the extra depth (24 vs 21 gates) compensates expressiveness. Cyclic ring + chord pattern is the unique minimal D6-invariant entangling structure on 6 sites.

proposals.note: Builds on c0005 (best dev risk 0.0061) by replacing the second RZZ layer's nearest-neighbor topology with next-nearest-neighbor (distance-2) cyclic bonds. This preserves the C6 cyclic-shift symmetry while introducing a complementary entanglement channel that couples qubits two apart, giving the Z_iZ_j readout access to longer-range correlations without adding parameters. The two RZZ layers together span a richer connectivity graph (distance-1 + distance-2 on a 6-ring) while keeping only 4 trainable angles, reducing overfitting risk on the 2-target regression.

proposals.note: Dihedral-symmetric ring ansatz: 6 RY(theta_0) + 6 RZZ(theta_2) on nearest-neighbor ring bonds + 6 RZZ(theta_3) on next-nearest-neighbor bonds + 6 RY(theta_1). Only 4 trainable parameters with full D6 invariance (cyclic shift + reflection). Entanglement layers (both RZZ sets) are placed contiguously between the two RY layers to maximize correlation depth for the Z_iZ_j readout before the second rotation layer re-mixes. The ring+NNN topology covers 12 of 15 pairs directly; the 3 opposite pairs (0,3),(1,4),(2,5) receive indirect correlation via the 2-layer, 2-repeat circuit. Fewer parameters than prior top candidates while preserving equivalent expressivity through symmetry-constrained tying.

proposals.note: D6-symmetric RY+RZZ block: 12 RY (tied p0/p2 per layer) + 12 RZZ on cycle edges (tied p1/p3 per layer). Full dihedral invariance (C6 rotation + reflection) constrains the ansatz to the orbit-averaged subspace, matching the uniform-site experimental geometry. Four parameters keep the optimization landscape smooth while the 24-gate depth provides sufficient expressivity for the two regression targets. This mirrors the top-scoring c0007 structure with identical gate budget and parameter count.

proposals.note: Interleaved RY/RZZ brick-wall on ring topology with bipartite parameter tying (even sites t0, odd sites t1; forward bonds t2, backward bonds t3). Alternating single- and two-qubit gates per site avoids the depth bottleneck of batched RY-then-RZZ layers, improving gradient flow through the 4 effective block applications (2 layers x 2 repeats). C3 cyclic symmetry (shift by 2) regularises the 4-parameter space while preserving enough expressivity for the 21-observable readout. Fewer effective degrees of freedom than prior 7-8 param proposals reduces overfitting risk on the 2-target regression.

proposals.note: Ring-topology RY/RZZ block with dihedral D6 symmetry (cyclic shift + reversal). 24 gates: 12 RY (2 per qubit, 2 tied params) + 12 RZZ (6 ring edges x 2 layers, 2 tied params). Key change vs c0007/c0008: both RZZ layers are placed contiguously between the two RY layers, creating a stronger entangling sandwich (RY-entangle-entangle-RY) that may improve gradient flow through the 2x2 block repetition while preserving exact D6 invariance of the ring. Four parameters keep the hypothesis space tight for the 21-observable linear readout.

proposals.note: Dihedral-symmetric ring+skip-1 ansatz: layer 1 uses nearest-neighbor RZZ (ring), layer 2 uses next-nearest-neighbor RZZ (skip-1 chord). Together they connect each qubit to 4 of 5 neighbors (missing only the 3 diameters), giving higher connectivity than a pure ring while preserving D6 invariance. Four tied parameters (theta_0,theta_1 for RY layers; phi_0,phi_1 for RZZ layers) keep capacity controlled. The skip-1 entanglement in the second layer provides longer-range correlations that the readout Z_iZ_j observables can exploit, differentiating from prior ring-only proposals (c0007/c0008) at the same gate/param budget.

proposals.note: Ring+next-nearest-ring RZZ topology. First entangling layer uses nearest-neighbor ring edges (i,i+1 mod 6); second uses next-nearest ring edges (i,i+2 mod 6). Both edge sets are invariant under the dihedral group D6 generated by the 6-cycle and the reversal, preserving the same relabeling symmetry as the best prior candidates (c0007/c0008) while providing richer multi-scale entanglement. Two RY layers with tied params (t1,t2) and two RZZ layers with tied params (t3,t4) keep parameter count at 4 for regularization. The longer-range RZZ connections in the second layer should help capture correlations between non-adjacent sites that the pure ring topology misses, potentially lowering MSE on both regression targets.
